limitations: These are diagnostic samples from the training set, not an independent student test set.
The models used different quantized weights and runtime environments, so this is not a fully isolated architecture comparison.
Blind-review judgments are diagnostic and should not be interpreted as a population accuracy estimate.
The 200 diagnostic cases were previously inspected during prompt development; this is a development comparison, not an unseen evaluation.
Reported ratings include 26 explicit lead adjudications after model-assisted blind reviews; reviewer errors and subjective cleanup judgments are recorded.
Only the AWQ build and non-thinking generation mode were tested; no conclusion about BF16 quality or independent judging capability.

controls.definition: Original sample stratum clean_or_passthrough; not human gold no-edit labels

decision: Candidate improves cleanup on this diagnostic sample (16 wins vs 3), but has 2 semantic failures vs baseline 1. Do not automatically replace all labels or use it as sole reviewer; run fixed difficult-case and realistic Chinese ASR validation before adoption.
